title: 🚨 YOU DON'T HAVE A PURPOSE PROBLEM.
paragraphs: 🚨 YOU DON'T HAVE A PURPOSE PROBLEM.
But many Christians spend years asking God for direction while ignoring the last thing He already told them to do.
Meanwhile, fear, comfort, distraction, and compromise quietly keep them stuck.
And many believers continue living BELOW the calling God placed on their lives.
HOW TO STOP LIVING BELOW YOUR CALLING
This is not another motivational book.
This is a biblical wake-up call.
A practical guide designed to help you break free from spiritual stagnation and start walking in the purpose God created you for.
✅ Why many believers never reach their God-given potential
✅ The hidden enemies sabotaging your calling
✅ How fear keeps people trapped in spiritual mediocrity
✅ How to renew your mind with biblical truth
✅ The daily disciplines that create lasting transformation
✅ How God used ordinary people like Moses, Gideon, and Jeremiah despite their excuses
✅ Practical steps to move from knowing your calling to actually living it
If you've been sensing God calling you higher...
Most people wait for the perfect moment.
Few people take the next faithful step.
